name: @veren/graph-core
description: Use when you need a business-agnostic directed-acyclic-graph execution kernel: it validates a neutral Node/Edge/Graph model, schedules nodes topologically with a concurrency cap, drives a per-node status machine, emits graph lifecycle events over the Cordis event bus, and applies a replaceable failure-propagation strategy; skip it when you want flow semantics (typed nodes, blackboard data) — those live in @veren/graph-flow-* on top of this kernel.
